stem: What was one effect of the Fugitive Slave Act of 1850?

options.label: A
options.text: The Republican Party lost influence in the federal legislature.

options.label: B
options.text: The Missouri Compromise was deemed unconstitutional by federal courts.

options.label: C
options.text: Tensions among the populations of northern and southern states increased.

options.label: D
options.text: Immigrants were forced to relocate from eastern cities to western territories.
